sources.title: Nightsinger's Reply
markers: | summary = '''Nightsinger's Reply''' is a passive feature that retaliates against enemies that hit the user with a melee attack.

summary: Medium Armour, base AC 13 plus up to +2 from Dexterity. While obscured, attackers that hit you in melee take 1d4 Necrotic.

fields.Use: Medium Armour, base AC 13 plus up to +2 from Dexterity. While obscured, attackers that hit you in melee take 1d4 Necrotic.
